metadata.title: Download NebulaCoop
metadata.description: Get the latest NebulaCoop for Windows. You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy.

page.paragraph_2: You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy.

current.paragraph_2: The button downloads Nebula-Setup.exe, NebulaCoop’s Setup. It isn’t code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen says “Unknown publisher”: choose More info, then Run anyway. Updates are signed, and Setup checks the signature before installing.

platforms.paragraph_2: Nebula runs on Linux, including Steam Deck. NebulaCoop’s Linux build is not ready yet.
platforms.paragraph_3: Nebula runs on macOS. NebulaCoop’s macOS build is not ready yet.
platforms.paragraph_4: Nebula runs on Android. NebulaCoop’s Android build is not ready yet.
platforms.paragraph_5: An iPhone and iPad version of Nebula is in development.

before.paragraph_1: NebulaCoop includes no game files. You need Super Mario Galaxy for Wii, revision 0: North America (RMGE01), Europe (RMGP01) or Japan (RMGJ01), as an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder. Everyone in a room needs their own copy.

footer.paragraph_1: Co-op by @Mackery6969, built on Nebula by @keepvaibin
